verses.html: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince's daughter! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.
verses.text: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince's daughter! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.

verses.html: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
verses.text: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.

verses.html: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.
verses.text: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.

verses.html: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bathrabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.
verses.text: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bathrabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.

verses.html: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.
verses.text: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.

verses.html: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
verses.text: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!

verses.html: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.
verses.text: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.

verses.html: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;
verses.text: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;

verses.html: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.
verses.text: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.

verses.html: I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me.
verses.text: I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me.

verses.html: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.
verses.text: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.

verses.html: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.
verses.text: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.

verses.html: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
verses.text: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
